tasks.notes: This is the starting gate for Epic 5. All Story 5.x tasks should depend on this task. Epic 5 can only start after Epic 4 is completed.
tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Read the corresponding epic file docs/prd/epic-5-game-flow-user-experience.md
2. Validate that each story in the epic file is represented by a task in the Shrimp task list
   - If there are stories with missing tasks, add a new task by following @.claude/commands/shrimp/create-task-from-bmad-story.md with the story number as the arguments.
3. Validate that each story task depends on this epic task
tasks.verificationCriteria: All stories (5.1 through 5.5) from Epic 5 are represented as tasks in Shrimp and properly depend on this starting task.
tasks.analysisResult: Create starting and completing tasks for Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience

tasks.name: Completing Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience
tasks.description: Complete Epic 5 by ensuring all game flow and user experience stories are finished. This task marks the successful completion of tutorial/onboarding, game over/victory screens, settings panel, navigation management, and final application polish - delivering a complete, production-ready 2048 app.
tasks.notes: This task depends on all Story 5.x tasks being completed and marks the end of Epic 5 and the entire project.
tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Read the corresponding epic file docs/prd/epic-5-game-flow-user-experience.md
2. Validate that each story in the epic file is represented by a task in the Shrimp task list
   - If there are stories with missing tasks, add a new task by following @.claude/commands/shrimp/create-task-from-bmad-story.md with the story number as the arguments.
   - Make the story task depend on the 'Starting Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience' task for this epic
   - Make this 'Completing Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience' task depend on the story
tasks.verificationCriteria: All stories (5.1 through 5.5) from Epic 5 are completed and the entire 2048 app project can be marked as finished and ready for app store submission.
tasks.analysisResult: Create starting and completing tasks for Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience

tasks.name: Story 5.1: Tutorial and Onboarding Experience
tasks.description: Create an interactive tutorial that teaches first-time players how to play 2048 for quick understanding of game mechanics. This includes tutorial screen with interactive demonstrations, step-by-step rule explanations, practice mode, completion tracking, accessibility support, and platform-appropriate presentation.
tasks.notes: First story in Epic 5 - provides onboarding for new users to the complete game experience.
tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Use a sub-agent to load the bmad-sm-draft-story agent, pass 'story 5.1' as arguments.
2. Use a sub-agent to load the bmad-dev-develop-story agent, pass 'story 5.1' as arguments.
3. Use a sub-agent to load the bmad-qa-review-story agent, pass 'story 5.1' as arguments.
tasks.verificationCriteria: The Status of docs/stories/5.1-story.md is Complete.
tasks.analysisResult: Create story-level tasks for Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience, covering stories 5.1 through 5.3.

tasks.name: Story 5.2: Game Over and Victory Screens
tasks.description: Provide clear feedback when games end and options for next actions to help players understand performance and continue playing seamlessly. This includes game over overlay, victory screen with celebration, continue playing option, new game/restart options, score comparison, and smooth transitions.
tasks.notes: Game end screens can develop parallel to tutorial as they serve different user journey points.

3. Use a sub-agent to load the bmad-qa-review-story agent, pass 'story 5.2' as arguments.
tasks.verificationCriteria: The Status of docs/stories/5.2-story.md is Complete.
tasks.analysisResult: Create story-level tasks for Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience, covering stories 5.1 through 5.3.

tasks.name: Story 5.3: Settings Panel and Preferences
tasks.description: Enable game experience customization through accessible settings to allow players to personalize the app to their preferences. This includes settings screen, theme selector with live preview, haptic feedback toggle, about section, settings persistence, and platform-appropriate presentation.
tasks.notes: Settings panel can develop parallel to other UX features as it's accessed independently.

tasks.analysisResult: Create story-level tasks for Epic 5: Game Flow & User Experience, covering stories 5.1 through 5.3.

tasks.name: Story 5.4: Navigation and Screen Management
tasks.description: Enable smooth navigation between game, tutorial, and settings screens for seamless access to all app features. This includes Expo Router navigation configuration, natural navigation transitions, back navigation handling, deep linking support, accessibility focus management, and platform-specific patterns.
tasks.notes: Navigation system should integrate with all other UX components (5.1-5.3) for seamless flow.

tasks.name: Story 5.5: Complete Application Polish and Testing
tasks.description: Deliver a polished, professional application experience without technical issues or poor usability. This includes final integration testing, performance optimization, accessibility audit, user acceptance testing, error handling, final deployment verification, and app store readiness preparation.
tasks.notes: Final polish requires all UX components (5.1-5.4) to be complete for comprehensive testing and optimization.
